question: What is the meaning of environmental impact indicators (from iso lca) in relation to performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)?
data_group: performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)
description: Environmental impact indicators in the context of ISO LCA are used to measure the potential environmental effects of a product system over its life cycle. These indicators are typically categorized into various types, such as human toxicity, ecotoxicity, water scarcity, land use, and others. They provide a standardized framework for assessing the environmental performance of products and materials. In contrast, performance indicators are used to evaluate the functional or operational performance of a product, such as its energy efficiency, durability, or user experience. While environmental impact indicators focus on the environmental effects of a product, performance indicators focus on its functional or operational aspects. Both types of indicators are essential for a comprehensive understanding of a product's overall sustainability and performance.
